## What would you like to improve?

Describe the task or problem and who the change would help.

## Suggested behaviour

Explain the proposed change and any alternatives considered.

## Data or indicator implications

Would this change affect input data, thresholds, age groups, denominators, formulas or geographic coverage? If so, describe the source and definition for maintainers to review.

## Additional context

Include examples or screenshots if helpful.
